messages.subject: Can I get the index of the selected item in optionButtons?
parts:
Hi,

I have a vector corresponding to each item in optonButtons. If I can get the selected index, that will be more convenient. Can I do that? Thank you.

Ziyuan

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Can I get the index of the selected item in optionButtons?
parts:
Do you mean checkboxGroupInput? There's no way to get the selected index, but you could simply make the value be the index.

choices <- 1:length(labels)
names(choices) <- labels

checkboxGroupInput('foo', 'Foo', choices)
